violation_type.title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §744.707)
violation_type.short_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation is not allowing parents to review, sign and receive a copy of incident reports within 48 hours

finding_variants.text: The operation is not allowing parents to review, sign and receive a copy of incident reports within 48 hours
The operation did not provide an incident report to the parent.
The operation did not create or share an incident report with the parents after children were involved in a situation that caused harm.
During the investigation, it was determined that the operation did not have the parent sign the incident report until five days after the injury occurred.
This standard was reviewed for this investigation.  Based on the information provided, the incident/illness report wasn't shared with the parent.
Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, the parent did not receive and sign an incident report within 48 hours of incident.
